digest.component_or_area: ticket summary and resolution contracts (library, CLI, MCP)
propositions: summary_compute resolves ticket state through show_state but omits the resolved alias from the return payload, causing agents to use collision-prone four-character prefixes instead of durable aliases
summary schema and CLI/library/MCP contracts institutionalize alias-free output shape, making short prefixes the most locally salient identifier
agent guidance lacks affirmative selection rules to prefer aliases for tracker commands while reserving canonical UUIDs for identity-sensitive artifacts
pinned behavioral evaluation shows local alias presence independently produces 25/25 alias-based commands versus 25/25 prefix-based commands without it, proving root cause
fix adds exact resolved alias as additive field to all resolvable summary results while preserving ticket_id echo and fail-closed ambiguity handling
